page.overview:
What is Autumn Dao?

Autumn Dao belongs to Mortal Kombat. The Autumn Dao is a modified dao, used by Dairou in Mortal Kombat: Deception and Mortal Kombat: Armageddon.

The weapon style and attacks of the Autumn Dao are similar to the Broadsword's. It differs considerably when compared to most normal daos.

The Autumn Dao can also be selected as a weapon in the Kreate a Fighter mode from Mortal Kombat: Armageddon.

The Autumn Dao can also be selected as a weapon in the Kreate a Fighter mode from Mortal Kombat: Armageddon.
